Registry · Re-scanned weekly

Every grade, one page.

The registry is a set of static Trust Cards for public MCP servers — independently scanned snapshots, not self-reports. Search, filter, and open any card for file:line evidence.

50 external targets (1 graded, 49 ungraded); 3 self-scans / fixtures, excluded from external statistics. Average graded external score: 96.0/100. D/F: 0 of 1 graded external targets.

U means insufficient static coverage, not a zero score or a safety verdict. Ungraded targets are excluded from score rankings and averages. Histogram and filters include all displayed targets, including labeled self-scans.
